note: Campground has waterfront tent sites, but RV sites are set back a ways from the water. --AWH Reached only by ferry from Marblehead (Kelleys Island Ferry, about 30 min, 419-798-9763): motor homes are priced by length, 23-26 ft $95 round trip, plus $13 per adult ($10 senior) each way; rates posted 2026, with an energy surcharge possible. No RV height or length limit is posted. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $31 base/+$10 electric/+$25 FHU, lakeview, AWH note kept verbatim. Added 50A + water + sewer, 124 sites (96 fit 23 ft), 50 ft max, showers/flush/dump, Apr 1-Oct 31, 14-night max, $6.50 fee, ferry costs in the note.
flags: FERRY (Kelleys Island Ferry Boat Lines, 510 W Main St, Marblehead; (419) 798-9763): rate sheet uploaded 2026/07, 'Trailers - Round Trip: Campers, Motor Homes, Travel Trailers, Boats & Trailers': 19-22 ft $85, 23-26 ft $95, 27-30 ft $110, 31-34 ft $125, 35-40 ft $130, over 40 ft +$12 per foot. Adults $13, seniors $10 one way. 'Kelleys Island Ferry can also accommodate tour buses, RVs, and tractor trailers.' 'All vehicles welcome.' About 30 minutes one way. It posts NO height or weight limit and no vehicle reservation rule, and its own rates imply vehicles far larger than EKKO fit. For two adults, a one-night trip adds about $147 ($95 + 4 x $13), which ReserveOhio's rate does not show.

WATERFRONT stays lakeview, agreeing with AWH: on NAIP leaf-on imagery the shore row (85, 87, 89, 91, 92, 93, 95, 97, 104) is the $35 premium non-electric type with IsRVSite false, ie tents, though rated 40-45 ft. The nearest RV-typed row (86, 88, 90, 94, 96, 98, 99, 100, 102; electric, rated 40-50 ft) plots about 30-70 m from the shore, behind that row and through trees. ODNR's 'A lakeside campground' and 'camping along the shores of the lake' do not change that.

SEASON CONFLICT: the campground page says 'Winter camping is available', the park page says 'This campground closes for the winter season', and the park office is 'closed in winter'. ReserveOhio sells no nights November through March. I wrote April 1-October 31 from the engine and the park page's statement.
PHONE MISSING: the entry has no phone field; ODNR's park office and camp number is (419) 746-2546 ('8am to 8pm in summer, closed in winter').
